title: Scientists Found WHAT Inside Your Brain?! 🤯 #shorts #sciencefacts
description:
New 2024 autopsy studies revealed that human brains now contain up to 0.5% microplastics by weight! Watch to see how it gets there and how to protect yourself.

#shorts #science #health #brainhealth #facts #didyouknow #biology

shots.voice_text: Scientists just sliced open human brains, and what they found inside is terrifying.
shots.caption: HUMAN BRAINS HAVE A *TERRIFYING SECRET*

shots.voice_text: New autopsy studies from 2024 revealed that your brain now contains about zero point five percent pure plastic by weight.
shots.caption: 0.5% OF YOUR BRAIN IS *PLASTIC*!

shots.voice_text: That's equivalent to an entire credit card worth of plastic sitting inside your skull. And the crazy part? You're drinking it every single day.
shots.caption: AN ENTIRE *CREDIT CARD* INSIDE YOU!

shots.voice_text: A single paper tea bag drops eleven billion microplastics into your cup. And microwaving food in plastic boxes unleashes millions more.
shots.caption: TEA BAGS RELEASE *11 BILLION* PARTICLES!

shots.voice_text: These particles are so tiny they cross the blood-brain barrier, triggering chronic inflammation, brain fog, and early memory decline.
shots.caption: CROSSES THE *BLOOD-BRAIN BARRIER*

shots.voice_text: Switch to glass or stainless steel bottles, and never heat plastic in the microwave. Because once it gets into your brain, there is no way out.
shots.caption: *NEVER HEAT PLASTIC!* NO WAY OUT.
